subject: Request: offer exception for Sr Infrastructure Engineer — signing bonus + equity refresh
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate Omar Reyes — comp exception request

Hi Mina,

Quick one — Omar Reyes (ex-BigCloud infra lead) completed interviews last week. Strong fit for the Sr Infrastructure Engineer role (SRE/infra lead on inference stack). We need to move fast; he has another verbal from a hyperscaler.

Comp ask vs band:
- Target base: $220,000 (our band midpoint for Sr Infra is $190k; this exceeds band by $30k)
- Signing bonus requested: $25,000 (one-time)
- Equity: candidate asked for 0.5% refresh behind existing offer; our guide was 0.25% for role.

Business justification:
- Deep systems reliability + scheduler experience we lack in-house. Short ramp to unblock a 3-month infra initiative.
- Hard to source at market — multiple competing offers.

Attachments: Omar resume + comp-band lookup.

Ask: can HR/Comp approve an exception (either base uplift or larger signing + equity refresh)? I'm proposing we prioritize a combination: small OOB base + sign-on, with accelerated vesting for first year.

I can loop in finance if needed. Candidate expects an answer by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Dylan

---
Attachment stubs: omar_reyes_resume.pdf; comp-band-lookup.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Omar Reyes — comp exception request

Dylan — thanks for the context and attachments. I pulled the comp-band sheet and looked at similar hires. A few quick notes:

- We can consider a limited out-of-band (OOB) increase, but anything >$15k over band midpoint needs director-level signoff and finance review.
- Signing bonuses are often the fastest lever to close a candidate without resetting base; that is preferable for long-term comp equity.
- Equity refresh at 0.5% is above our typical refresh window for individual ICs; we could approve a one-time refresh at 0.35% with accelerated front-loaded vesting if leadership signs off.

Please confirm: is the $220k firm or would Omar accept $210k + $20k sign-on + 0.35% equity with 18-month 50% cliff (25% up front at 6 months)? If yes, I will prepare an exception packet and route to Finance and Vivek for approval.

I’m attaching the offer-term-sheet template to speed things up.

-Mina
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

> Dylan — thanks for the context and attachments. I pulled the comp-band sheet and looked at similar hires. A few quick notes:
> 
> - We can consider a limited out-of-band (OOB) increase, but anything >$15k over band midpoint needs director-level signoff and finance review.
> - Signing bonuses are often the fastest lever to close a candidate without resetting base; that is preferable for long-term comp equity.
> - Equity refresh at 0.5% is above our typical refresh window for individual ICs; we could approve a one-time refresh at 0.35% with accelerated front-loaded vesting if leadership signs off.

Mina — thanks. My preference is to minimize base creep. Approve the following as a default:

- Base: up to $205,000 (i.e., $15k over midpoint)
- Signing bonus: up to $20,000 one-time
- Equity refresh: 0.35% with 50% vesting in the first 12 months (to align incentives)

If Dylan believes $220k is make-or-break, we need Vivek to sign off given budget implications. Vivek — can you evaluate the headcount/comp pool impact? If you approve full $220k + $25k sign-on, mark the approval and I’ll route to Payroll.

-Laura
VP, Talent Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Omar Reyes — comp exception request

Thanks team — reviewed the case and business impact. Given the candidate timeline and the immediate infra ramp, I'm comfortable approving a middle-ground exception with these constraints:

- Base: approve $210,000 (OOB by $20k)
- Signing bonus: approve $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity refresh: approve 0.35% with 50% vesting in year one, remainder standard schedule

Conditions: HR must document the exception with the RE-2027-045 form and log the headcount/comp delta to the FY27 hiring forecast. Hiring manager (Dylan) must confirm a 6-month performance checkpoint and provide a 30/60/90 plan. Payroll/Finance to confirm tax/timing for the sign-on.

Approval reference: APPROVAL-RE-2027-045

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Engineering (interim)
Redwood Inference
